title: Service lifecycle is part of storage safety
summary: Storage safety depends on the lifecycle of the provider/account/service as well as the physical medium. Fast, large storage on a temporary trial can be excellent working space while being explicitly unsafe as the sole durable copy.
invariants: SAFE/DISPOSABLE/UNKNOWN safety is distinct from STABLE/TEMPORARY/CREDIT_LIMITED/EXPIRING/TERMINATING lifecycle state.
Only AVAILABLE, VERIFIED, SAFE, STABLE locations count as durable replicas in v0.1-dev5.
A verified disposable copy does not authorize eviction of the last safe durable replica.
A pool whose service lifecycle is non-STABLE cannot satisfy durable safety even if the underlying media is physically persistent.
TERMINATING service capacity accepts no new workspace allocation.
Disposable capacity is valid for scratch, intermediates, caches, replicated inputs and recomputable outputs, but required durable results must be committed elsewhere before completion.

provenance.claim: Regression proves disposable/credit-limited workspace is not durable safety, including eviction protection and terminating-state admission.
